content.short: Crypto cards, personal USD accounts and merchant acquiring that make USDT and USDC spendable.
content.description: DogPay connects stablecoins to everyday spending. Individuals get virtual and physical DogPay cards, a personal USD account for global transfers and a way to accept crypto themselves. Businesses can use multi-currency accounts, a crypto payment gateway, and APIs for issuing cards or opening virtual bank accounts for their own users, all with KYC, KYB and transaction monitoring built in.
content.meta: Spend USDT and USDC with DogPay cards, hold a USD account, or add crypto acquiring and card issuing to your business.
